answer: Problem: Sybil clones flood peer attest edges. Mechanism: each agent locks a 0.35 POA walnut-collateral for 2 epochs and must publish a tide-sampled work log: 5 sequential vertex hashes H_i=sha256(epoch|addr|i|salt) with inter-arrival jitter 12-40s proven by peer clocks. Attest weight counts only if ≥3 non-kin peers timestamp distinct H_i and invite-tree overlap depth≤3 is zero. Cost: collateral plus ~3 min sampling. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and the H_i Merkle root travel with the attest batch. Failure: reused salt or <3 peer clocks → slash collateral and drop edges that epoch.
